email_subject: Application - Marketing Associate for Clinical Education (Peripheral Vascular, EMEA)
email_body:
Dear Stryker Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Marketing Associate for Clinical Education role in your Peripheral Vascular division. My background is digital marketing with a technical edge: SEO, content and web. I write content people can find and actually read, and I build the structures that keep it usable at scale.

At Episto I manage content for client websites in WordPress, and I built a WordPress/Elementor site with a consistent layout across some 600 member profile pages. That is the same care with detail that educational material for sales teams and healthcare professionals demands. Earlier I worked with a team on SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores) and Aras Kargo, and I developed front-end features for a healthcare web application at ViviDoctor in Belgium.

I am fluent in English, based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and glad to travel. I would welcome the chance to talk.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Stryker Hiring Team,

Your posting describes turning clinical evidence into content that sales teams and healthcare professionals can use well. That is a content problem and a clarity problem, and it is the kind I like working on.

I am a digital marketer with a technical background. At Episto I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and content for client websites, publishing and maintaining pages in WordPress, and tracking whether any of it works in Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console. One project I am proud of is a WordPress/Elementor site for a pharmacists' association, where I built and maintain a consistent layout across roughly 600 member profile pages. That is the kind of detail work that matters when people rely on information, and when a template has to hold up at scale.

Earlier I worked with a team at Knowledge Experts on SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for ŞOK Market, a retailer with 4,000+ stores, and for Aras Kargo, where 12,000 staff use an internal application gallery. I learned there how differently internal audiences read compared with external ones, and how much of adoption comes down to communication and organization rather than technology. Before that I built front-end features for a healthcare web application at ViviDoctor in Belgium, which is where my interest in healthcare started.

I have not worked in medical devices. What I bring is content and CMS craft, comfort with technical detail, and a habit of learning a domain quickly, plus fluent English and Turkish and Dutch at a basic to intermediate level. I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and the 60% travel this role involves suits me.

I would be glad to discuss how I could support your Peripheral Vascular clinical education programs.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
- Content and CMS work: on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites, publishing and maintaining pages, blog posts and media in WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math).

- Internal-audience platforms: supported the team on SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores, ERP/POS integration) and Aras Kargo (application gallery for 12,000 staff).
- Healthcare exposure: developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application at ViviDoctor, Belgium (AngularJS, JavaScript).
- Communication and analysis: fluent English, native Turkish, Dutch at B1 writing / A2+ speaking; reporting in Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs; based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium and available for 60% travel.
